name: Hybrid Ray-Casting
definition: A ray-casting variant that produces an intermediate image aligned with one of the volume faces and then transforms it to the view direction to achieve a one-to-one mapping of ray-samples onto the volume.
summary: Hybrid Ray-Casting renders volumes by casting rays on an aligned base plane for regular memory access, then warping the result to the view plane, unlike standard methods that resample directly in view space.
